verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS marketing platform that holds contact data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only email creation, scheduling, recipient exclusion, analytics, and integrations. Nothing documents retention policies, data deletion, or erasure controls; excluding contacts from a send is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
